description.value: Toku Japanese Restaurant is a Japanese dining destination inside Lansdowne Centre in Richmond, specializing in sushi rolls, sashimi, chirashi, and desserts made with high-quality seafood and house secret sauces. The restaurant offers ample seating suited for large gatherings and includes a kids' area, making it a welcoming sit-down stop for groups. It is currently celebrating its 10th anniversary and offers online pick-up ordering.
